Package com.javiergs.turtle4j

Class RosbridgeConnection

java.lang.Object
com.javiergs.turtle4j.RosbridgeConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class RosbridgeConnection extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Minimal rosbridge WebSocket topic client. It is not thread-safe, and does not support all rosbridge features. It is intended for educational purposes only.
Version:
1.0 (2026-10-26)
Author:
javiergs

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public void connect() throws Exception
      Connects to rosbridge and starts receiving WebSocket messages.
      Throws:
      Exception - if connection setup fails or times out
      IllegalStateException - if already connected

    • publish

      public void publish(String topic, String type, Object message)
      Publishes a JSON-serializable message through rosbridge.
      Parameters:
      topic - destination ROS 2 topic
      type - ROS 2 message type
      message - JSON-serializable message payload
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if not connected

    • subscribe

      public void subscribe(String topic, String type, Consumer<com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode> callback)
      Subscribes to a topic with one callback per topic.
      Parameters:
      topic - source ROS 2 topic
      type - ROS 2 message type
      callback - receives the decoded message payload
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if callback is null
      IllegalStateException - if not connected

    • unsubscribe

      public void unsubscribe(String topic)
      Unsubscribes from a topic and removes its registered callback. Does nothing when the topic is not currently subscribed.
      Parameters:
      topic - subscribed ROS 2 topic
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the unsubscribe request cannot be sent

    • callService

      public com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode callService(String service, Object args) throws Exception
      Calls a ROS 2 service through rosbridge, matching the response by request ID. Do not call from a WebSocket callback, because this method blocks.
      Parameters:
      service - ROS 2 service name
      args - JSON-serializable request fields
      Returns:
      service response values
      Throws:
      Exception - if the service fails, the connection closes, or the call times out

    • discoverTopics

      public com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.JsonNode discoverTopics() throws Exception
      Queries rosapi for live topic names and their advertised ROS message types. Requires rosapi to be running alongside rosbridge.
      Returns:
      rosapi topics response containing topics and types arrays
      Throws:
      Exception - if discovery fails or times out

    • discoverServices
